open_internal_inlet_refinement_kind: short compatibility strip plus Gmsh Extend from cavity-side inlet boundary
open_internal_inlet_normal_size_rule: short y1-compatible strip followed by Gmsh Extend(SizeBnd)
open_internal_inlet_refinement_scope: cavity surface only; exterior field is unaffected
open_profile_note: Open profile written without artificial fabric thickness. The exterior BL follows the uncut base-profile inlet arc; only the actual cut wall becomes airfoil_wall, and the cavity/exterior inlet interface is stitched before one-cell extrusion.

engineering_quality_assessment.label: Buena
engineering_quality_assessment.summary: checkMesh es OK, pero la calificacion de margen numerico es B (Buena). No valida independencia de malla, y+, convergencia ni exactitud aerodinamica.
engineering_quality_assessment.aspect_ratio_note: El aspect ratio alto no se penaliza de forma aislada en una BL prismatica; debe estar alineado con la pared y acompanado de buena ortogonalidad, skewness y crecimiento suave.
technical_basis: OpenFOAM Foundation checkMesh limits parsed from the real case log.
OpenFOAM guidance on non-orthogonal correction stability near 75 degrees.
Ram-air open-airfoil grid study: wall skewness and orthogonality are decision-critical.

metric_descriptions.status: Overall internal quality status from this Python controller. It is stricter than OpenFOAM checkMesh for some diagnostic metrics.
metric_descriptions.openfoam_execution_gate: Whether this mesh can continue to OpenFOAM in the debug workflow. OK requires gmshToFoam OK, checkMesh OK, a real polyMesh and valid 2D empty front/back patches.
metric_descriptions.gmshToFoam_status: Status of conversion from Gmsh .msh to OpenFOAM polyMesh.
metric_descriptions.gmshToFoam_wall_time_s: Elapsed wall-clock seconds spent by the real gmshToFoam conversion.
metric_descriptions.checkMesh_status: OpenFOAM checkMesh result. This is the primary safety gate for running OpenFOAM in the debug workflow.
metric_descriptions.checkMesh_wall_time_s: Elapsed wall-clock seconds spent by checkMesh -allTopology -allGeometry.
metric_descriptions.checkMesh_max_non_orthogonality_deg: Maximum angle between face normal and cell-centre vector. Lower is better; OpenFOAM reports severe faces above 70 deg.
metric_descriptions.checkMesh_max_skewness: OpenFOAM skewness metric. High values indicate distorted cells/faces.
metric_descriptions.checkMesh_min_face_interpolation_weight: Minimum interpolation weight. Very small values indicate poor cell-centre alignment across a face.
metric_descriptions.checkMesh_min_face_volume_ratio: Minimum volume ratio between neighboring cells. Very small values indicate abrupt local size transitions.
metric_descriptions.checkMesh_min_cell_determinant: Minimum cell well-posedness determinant. Small values indicate poor cells.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_layers_created: Whether the parser could confirm boundary-layer cells. For extruded quad BL this is inferred from hex elements.
metric_descriptions.number_of_hexes: Hexahedral cells, usually produced by recombined prism/quad boundary-layer extrusion.
metric_descriptions.number_of_prisms: Prismatic cells in the extruded OpenFOAM 2D mesh.
metric_descriptions.estimated_cell_count: Estimated volume cell count parsed from the mesh file.
metric_descriptions.estimated_cell_count_source: Source used for estimated_cell_count. Prefer Gmsh .msh parsing; fallback is OpenFOAM checkMesh cell count.
metric_descriptions.gmsh_log_nodes: Node count reported directly by Gmsh in log.gmsh.
metric_descriptions.gmsh_log_elements: Element count reported directly by Gmsh in log.gmsh.
metric_descriptions.mesh_file_size_mb: Size of the generated .msh file. Large meshes may skip the internal Python parser to avoid slow post-Gmsh processing.
metric_descriptions.msh_parse_skipped: True when the internal Python .msh parser was intentionally skipped because the mesh exceeded configured size/count limits.
metric_descriptions.msh_parse_skip_reason: Reason the internal Python .msh parser was skipped.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_confirmation_basis: Evidence used to decide whether boundary-layer-like cells were created.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_exact_layer_count_confirm: Whether the exact requested number of BL layers was automatically counted. False means inspect the mesh visually.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_candidate_hex_cells: Hexahedral volume cells detected; expected when quad BL cells are recombined and extruded.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_candidate_prism_cells: Prismatic volume cells detected; common in extruded triangular/prismatic 2D OpenFOAM meshes.
metric_descriptions.checkMesh_cell_count: Cell count reported by OpenFOAM checkMesh.
metric_descriptions.effective_gmsh_mesh_algorithm_2d: Gmsh 2D meshing algorithm passed to Mesh.Algorithm in the .geo file. In this workflow 5=Delaunay is used for robust debug meshing; 6=Frontal-Delaunay may give smoother meshes but was less robust with the current BoundaryLayer field.
metric_descriptions.effective_gmsh_random_factor: Gmsh coordinate randomization factor used to avoid exact coincident points in triangulation. A small non-zero value helps after dense wall/BoundaryLayer offsets.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_first_cell_height_chord: First boundary-layer cell height actually written to Gmsh, nondimensionalized by chord.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_first_cell_height_m: First boundary-layer cell height actually written to Gmsh, in metres.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_requested_first_cell_heig: First boundary-layer cell height requested by the input configuration before any robustness cap is applied.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_total_thickness_chord: Total BoundaryLayer field thickness actually written to Gmsh, nondimensionalized by chord.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_raw_total_thickness_chord: Total BoundaryLayer thickness implied by requested first cell, growth and layer count before any optional thickness override.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_total_thickness_limited: True only when an explicit BoundaryLayer total-thickness override reduced the raw requested thickness.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_curve_ids: Gmsh curve IDs included in Field[1].CurvesList for the BoundaryLayer field.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_excluded_te_curve_ids: TE closure/cap curve IDs intentionally excluded from BoundaryLayer.CurvesList to avoid synthetic BL edge recovery failures at very short closure curves.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_first_cell_height_source: Source of the first boundary-layer height: config override, y+ flat-plate estimate, or fallback.
metric_descriptions.boundary_layer_yplus_estimate: Traceable flat-plate y+ estimate used when the first-cell-height override is null.
metric_descriptions.closed_airfoil_target_nodes: Target total tangential nodes for the closed-profile wall curves written with Gmsh Transfinite Curve.
metric_descriptions.closed_te_target_nodes: Target tangential nodes allocated to rounded TE cap curves in the closed debug profile.
metric_descriptions.closed_te_cap_curve_ids: Gmsh curve IDs representing the closed rounded TE cap.
metric_descriptions.gmsh_manual_discretization_note: Reminder that Gmsh Transfinite Curve controls wall tangential divisions while BoundaryLayer controls normal layers.
metric_descriptions.open_boundary_layer_curve_ids: Open diagnostic Gmsh curve IDs included in the BoundaryLayer field.
metric_descriptions.open_boundary_layer_excluded_te_curve_id: Open diagnostic TE cap curve IDs intentionally excluded from BoundaryLayer.CurvesList.
metric_descriptions.open_fluid_topology: Topology used for open-profile meshing. The supported path uses conformal exterior, inlet-transition and cavity surfaces that form one connected solver fluid region around a finite-thickness fabric solid.
metric_descriptions.open_connected_fluid_surface: True when the open-profile exterior and internal cavity are one connected fluid region through the inlet gap.
metric_descriptions.open_boundary_layer_single_loop_bspline: True when the open debug BL is requested on one closed diagnostic loop to avoid short independent inlet/TE BL curves.
metric_descriptions.open_boundary_layer_single_loop_curve_ki: Gmsh curve primitive used for the single open debug BL loop. Spline interpolates the profile points; BSpline treats them as control points.
metric_descriptions.open_boundary_layer_single_loop_transfin: True when a Transfinite Curve constraint is applied to the single open debug BL loop. False lets local point sizes control surface discretization.
metric_descriptions.open_boundary_layer_curve_policy: Human-readable summary of which open-profile curves are used in the Gmsh BoundaryLayer field.
metric_descriptions.open_surface_target_nodes: Target total tangential nodes for the open exterior wall curves written with Gmsh Transfinite Curve.
metric_descriptions.open_zero_thickness_contour_target_nodes: Total tangential segments distributed by arc length over the complete zero-thickness wall/TE/nonphysical-inlet loop.
metric_descriptions.open_zero_thickness_uniform_spacing_chor: Common target tangential spacing divided by chord. It prevents a discretization jump where the boundary role changes at an inlet lip.
metric_descriptions.open_outer_wall_transfinite_curve_nodes: Actual Gmsh Transfinite Curve node counts written for each open exterior wall curve.
metric_descriptions.open_lip_transfinite_min_nodes: Minimum node count imposed on open upper/lower exterior wall curves so the inlet lips are not under-discretized.
metric_descriptions.open_inlet_refinement_bridge_enabled: True when a non-physical embedded line is written across the inlet only to control mesh size; it is not a wall patch.
metric_descriptions.open_inlet_refinement_bridge_curve_ids: Gmsh curve IDs of non-physical embedded inlet sizing markers.
metric_descriptions.open_inlet_refinement_bridge_in_boundary: Whether the nonphysical inlet bridge participates in the exterior BoundaryLayer loop. It is never exported as a physical wall patch.
metric_descriptions.open_boundary_layer_inlet_bridge_in_sing: True when the geometric inlet bridge is part of the single closed diagnostic BL loop, without using the inlet marker as a physical wall patch.
metric_descriptions.open_internal_cavity_meshed: True when the internal cavity fluid surface is triangulated and included in the open-profile mesh.
metric_descriptions.open_internal_cavity_curve_mode: How the internal fabric boundary is written. Continuous splines reduce curve fragmentation while preserving ordered input points.
metric_descriptions.open_inlet_transition_mesh: Element strategy for the narrow fluid connector between exterior and cavity. The supported transfinite/recombined strip avoids degenerate free-triangulation diagonals without creating a wall patch.
metric_descriptions.open_interface_sizes_from_boundary_layer: True when local TE/inlet triangle targets are derived from the final BL-layer height and actual tangential curve spacing instead of a global manual size.
metric_descriptions.open_te_interface_size_chord: Active local triangle target at the rounded TE, divided by chord.
metric_descriptions.open_inlet_interface_size_chord: Active local triangle target on both sides of the nonphysical inlet interface, divided by chord.
metric_descriptions.open_lip_cap_interface_size_chord: Highly local triangle target adjacent to the finite-thickness lip cap, divided by chord.
metric_descriptions.open_internal_cavity_solver_connected: True when the internal cavity is part of the same solver fluid topology as the exterior. False means separate diagnostic internal triangles.
metric_descriptions.open_internal_cavity_note: Explanation of the diagnostic internal cavity topology and Gmsh BoundaryLayer limitations.
